name: Davco Davelastic
paste:
DAVCO DAVELASTIC: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Davco Davelastic, February 2022, Version 01.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/y/davco-davelastic.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Davco Davelastic where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (February 2022, Version 01.01).
1.2 Product description. A concentrated tile adhesive additive designed to increase flexibility, strength and water resistance of cement-based products.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Suitable for interior and exterior applications. Davco Davelastic being an acrylic polymer creates water resistance in mortars, which enables them to be used in wet areas including concrete swimming pools, spas and external façades.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.5.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Davco Davelastic
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (February 2022, Version 01.01) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - SCAQMD method 304-91: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Product Information > Volatile organic compound (VOC) content (p.1).
    - AS3958: referred to in instructions or limitations. Where: Important Considerations (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Increases flexibility, strength and water resistance of cement based tile adhesives
    - Ideal for submerged, façade and high foot traffic tiling applications
    - Use when tiling over existing tiles
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance / Colour: White liquid
    - Specific gravity: 1.01kg/L
    - Volatile organic compound (VOC) content: Low VOC - 1g/L (SCAQMD method 304-91)
2.6 Product Declaration.
    | Tile adhesive | Davelastic | Water | Classification |
    | Davco SMP EVO | 2.5Ltrs | 2.5Ltrs | C2TS2 |
    | (C2TES1) |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
2.7 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Available in a 1Ltr or 5Ltr jerry cans or a 20L pail
    - Shelf life: 12 months from date of manufacturer if unopened.
    - Storage conditions: Store in dry cool conditions our of direct sunlight.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (February 2022, Version 01.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate preparation.
    - All surfaces must be installed according to manufacturer’s instructions and relevant Australian Standard(s) and be structurally sound, dry, clean and free from movement, oil, grease, wax, sealers, curing compounds, release agents and any other loose or contaminating material. Thoroughly clean old surfaces, or new surfaces that have been treated, prior to tiling
    - Deeply contaminated surfaces must be scabbled / abraded to a clean, sound surface; Expose at least 80% of the original substrate of painted surfaces
    - Surfaces should be prepared and primed in accordance to the relevant tile adhesive product datasheet

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (February 2022, Version 01.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Recommended dosage. Davelastic must be diluted with clean, potable water at a ratio of 1 to 1 for use as an additive in cement based tile adhesives. Thoroughly mix the required amount of Davelastic and water together prior to mixing with the adhesive.
4.3 Application - Tile Adhesive Mix Process. 1. Add the required amount of Davco Davelastic and water mixture into a clean bucket. 2. Slowly add the powder to the liquid while mixing with a mixing paddle attached to a drill. Always add the powder to the liquid. Do not mix by hand. + 3. Continue to mix for several minutes until a creamy consistency is achieved, free of lumps of powder. 4. Allow mixture to stand for 5 minutes, remix then use the adhesive.
    - The tile adhesive should be applied as per the instructions for the adhesive, including all surface preparation Note: Davco Davelastic will increase the tackiness of the adhesive as well as reduce the pot life, open time and adjustment time.
4.4 Cleaning of tools. Tools and equipement can be cleaned prior to setting.
4.5 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Test product in an inconspicuous area first
    - Over movement joints in the substrate
    - At a junction between different substrate materials
    - At fixtures interrupting the tile surface e.g. columns
    - At internal vertical corners
    - Around the perimeter of the tiling system
    - At a maximum of 4.5m centres, in a grid pattern
    - Movement joints should be kept free from dirt and adhesive droppings
    - All movement joints can be filled with Davco Elite A Silicone or Sika flexible sealant
    It is essential to plan the area to be tiled, with inclusion of movement joints in accordance with the Australian Standard AS3958 “Guide to the Installation of Ceramic Tiles.” Failure to do so may result in drummy or lifting tiles. Make sure normal building or surface movement is accommodated by installing movement joints as follows:

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (February 2022, Version 01.01) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Trials, test areas and compatibility checks stated by the manufacturer.
    - Test product in an inconspicuous area first
5.4 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Davco Davelastic, February 2022, Version 01.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/y/davco-davelastic.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Davelastic, version 09/04/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/c/MSDS%20Davelastic%20GHS7.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Material Safety Data Sheet containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
